rule_text_quote: NBIM's own materials describe the 2017-2019 transition two different ways: the GIPS report states the formal 'strategic weight' was flat at 62.5% for the whole period 1 Jan 2017 to 1 May 2019 (jumping discretely to 70% only on that date), while the 2019 phase-in letter describes 'gradually increasing the equity share IN THE STRATEGIC BENCHMARK INDEX' over the 20-month window. These are not fully reconcilable from the public text alone; treat any single 2017/2018 'strategic weight' figure with caution.
